audited_candidates.source: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents, arXiv:2607.12227

artifact.held_out_example: configs/experiments/exp-simple-code-gpt54-w-test.yaml explicitly enumerates 34 Terminal-Bench 2.1 test tasks and references train/val split configs

environment.benchmark_material: Terminal-Bench 2.1 task directory must be supplied locally and E2B templates built before rollout

reproducibility_assessment.judgment: The paper's core evaluation protocol is materially reproducible from public author code: matched-budget baselines, evolution paths, blind rollout selection, held-out evaluation commands, explicit split configs, and per-run artifact outputs are documented. This strengthens traceability of the negative-control result but is not an independent rerun.
exact_blockers: No uv.lock was found at the audited commit, so the environment is not fully frozen.
The pyproject pins NexAU to v0.3.9 but references Curry09/harbor-LJH without a commit/tag pin; later upstream drift can change behavior.
Exact rerun requires paid/proprietary model-provider access and E2B infrastructure; model service behavior may drift independently of repository commit.
The Terminal-Bench 2.1 task material is not self-contained in the repository; the user must provide the benchmark directory.
No independent public benchmark rerun reproducing the paper's Table 1/2/3 numbers was located in the targeted search.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Supports reproducibility of the released evaluation implementation and exact split definitions for Terminal-Bench 2.1. It does not independently establish the numerical results and does not imply harness evolution is generally ineffective outside the tested benchmark/models/budgets.

artifact.implementation_scope: Independent repo implements fast-loop and slow-loop machinery, benchmark adapters and offline toy/proxy experiments; README explicitly states paper absolute numbers were not reproduced with the paper's 31B backbone.

reproducibility_assessment.failed_independent_replication: yes, for the reimplementation author's separate small live target-transfer hypothesis
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: This is useful independent implementation evidence that the two-timescale mechanism can be instantiated and tested, but it is not a benchmark replication of the paper's OfficeQA/SealQA/ALFWorld gains. The reproducer retracted its own initially positive live target-transfer signal after a 3-seed larger rerun: per-seed meta-gains +0.12/-0.21/-0.21, mean -0.10 +/- 0.16; neither single-level nor two-level beat the seed baseline. This null is evidence about that small bare-LLM target-transfer setup only, not evidence against MetaSkill-Evolve's published benchmark result or the mechanism family.
exact_blockers: The reproducer says the paper's Gemma-4 31B setup does not fit the available 24 GB local hardware.
Real benchmark reproduction requires model/provider access and benchmark datasets; OfficeQA requires a HuggingFace access request.
The repo's green tests and toy proxy gains verify implementation behavior, not the paper's reported benchmark effect sizes.
No independent reproduction of the paper's +6.38/+8.05/+1.92 marginal slow-loop gains was identified in this targeted pass.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Independent evidence supports implementability and exposes a negative-transfer/overfitting risk in one separate small-scale setup. Do not treat the null as a failed replication of the paper's main benchmark claim.

artifact.environment_lock: uv.lock present with package hashes; Python >=3.12
artifact.benchmark_scaffolding: Committed run presets, data-prep scripts, deterministic task-map manifests, benchmark-specific integration docs and output/trace conventions for ARC-AGI-1/2, Polyglot, SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 2.
artifact.task_identity_example: ARC-AGI-1 train-50 seed-0 task map pins fchollet/ARC-AGI source commit 399030444e0ab0cc8b4e199870fb20b863846f34 and deterministic random.Random(seed).sample selection.
artifact.terminalbench_submodule: harbor-framework/terminal-bench-2 pinned as gitlink 53ff2b87d621bdb97b455671f2bd9728b7d86c11 at the audited KSI commit.
artifact.paper_run_wrapper_example: benchmarks/run_arc.sh labels the paper OURS matrix, fixes model choices, generation defaults, task-map use, seeds, runtime timeout, output JSON and SQLite artifact paths, and forum/no-forum conditions.

reproducibility_assessment.independent_replication: not identified in this targeted pass
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: KSI has unusually strong author-side reproducibility infrastructure: a hashed environment lock, deterministic task maps with upstream commits, explicit benchmark preparation, paper-oriented run wrappers, CI/tests, trace/output conventions, and a pinned Terminal-Bench submodule gitlink. This makes the implementation and benchmark protocol substantially reconstructable from a fixed commit. It still does not constitute an independent rerun of the paper's numerical gains.
exact_blockers: Benchmark datasets are intentionally not committed; exact reruns require fetching upstream datasets according to preparation docs.
Live paper runs require provider credentials and external model services, so model/provider drift cannot be eliminated by repository pinning alone.
The repository documents where run results land, but no committed results/ directory containing the paper's complete raw numerical run outputs was found at the audited commit in this pass.

The .gitmodules file tracks Terminal-Bench branch main, although the audited parent commit itself pins the submodule gitlink to 53ff2b87d621bdb97b455671f2bd9728b7d86c11; users must initialize at that recorded gitlink rather than update to branch tip.

The repo itself notes unresolved Docker-image digest drift in Terminal-Bench 2 and proposes upstream content digest pinning; tag-level environment identity is therefore not fully guaranteed for historical TB2 reruns.
Targeted public search found author/project pages and commentary/reviews but no independent benchmark rerun reproducing KSI's ARC/Polyglot/SWE-bench Pro/TB2 headline cells.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Strong evidence that the published procedure is author-reproducible and inspectable. The reported 3-seed gains and cross-model/held-out transfer remain primary-study evidence until independently rerun; do not treat reviews or cross-paper convergence commentary as replication.

artifact.note: Existing clean comparator evidence already records Terminal-Bench team verification of the released final harness result.

reproducibility_assessment.official_artifact_support: strong for released framework/final Terminal-Bench harness
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: The official reference code is public, but its README explicitly says it is a cleaned-up version of the paper code and was only checked to run. Existing clean evidence correctly treats the benchmark-team rerun of the final Terminal-Bench harness as partial external validation, not replication of the outer-loop search or the raw-traces-vs-summary causal ablation.
exact_blockers: No independent public rerun of the central raw-traces versus compressed-summary ablation was found in the targeted search.
No independent public reproduction of the reported text-classification +7.7-point or five-held-out-model math +4.7-point results was found.
The authors' released reference repo is cleaned up from the actual research code, so exact historical execution identity is not guaranteed by the repository alone.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Retain strong paper evidence and partial external validation, but do not label the central trace-access mechanism independently replicated.

pipeline_effect.new_material_correction: self_improvement/C3 has a concrete independent reimplementation whose separate small live target-transfer positive signal was retracted after replication to a null/negative mean; this must not be misclassified as a failed replication of the paper's benchmark result.

pipeline_effect.ksi_scope: self_improvement/C4 has very strong author-side reproducibility infrastructure but no independent numerical rerun identified; do not upgrade primary-study results to independently replicated.
